name: Grok-2

lifecycle.note: Refers to the Grok 2 weights that xAI published on Hugging Face in August 2025, which remain downloadable; xAI does not say which Grok-2 version they are. The xAI API models page lists no Grok-2 model (checked 2026-10-01), and xAI published no retirement notice for the August 2024 model in its products.

released.note: Released as an early preview in beta on X for Premium and Premium+ users; enterprise API access was announced for later in August 2024.

date.note: The card gives no date; the repository's commit history shows the weights uploaded on 2025-08-22 (UTC) and the model card added on 2025-08-23. xAI describes the weights only as Grok 2, a model trained and used at xAI in 2024, so they may belong to the December 2024 revision instead.

summary.text: Grok-2 is a language model from xAI with text and vision understanding, released on 13 August 2024 as an early beta on X for Premium and Premium+ subscribers, together with Grok-2 mini, with an enterprise API announced for later that month. In August 2025 xAI published weights it calls Grok 2 on Hugging Face under the Grok 2 Community License Agreement.

changes.text: xAI reports improvements in chat, coding and reasoning over Grok-1.5.
xAI says it reasons better with retrieved content and is better at tool use.

sources.locator: Grok-2 language model and chat capabilities

changes.text: xAI describes the model as having vision understanding; at launch, multimodal understanding on X and in the API was announced as coming soon.

changes.text: Offered through a new enterprise API, announced for later in August 2024, in addition to Grok on X.

inputModalities.note: xAI says Grok-2 has text and vision understanding capabilities and reports results on visual tasks; at launch it described multimodal understanding on X and the API as coming soon.

parameters.note: Not disclosed by xAI; the Hugging Face card gives only the download size of the weights.

openWeights.note: Weights of Grok 2 under the Grok 2 Community License Agreement (now titled xAI Community License Agreement), published in August 2025; xAI does not say which Grok-2 version they are.

sources.locator: second paragraph; Build with Grok using the Enterprise API

access.note: At launch in beta on X for Premium and Premium+ users, with the enterprise API announced for later in August 2024; weights downloadable since August 2025.

notes: An early version was tested on the LMSYS Chatbot Arena under the name sus-column-r (per the announcement). Announced together with Grok-2 mini (xai.grok-2-mini). The December 2024 version is a separate record (xai.grok-2-2024-12). Version of the open weights: the Hugging Face repository is named grok-2 and does not say whether it holds the August or the December 2024 model.
